queries.query: Our analytics dashboard feels bland and cluttered. Redesign it so it feels more premium and trustworthy, and use your judgment on the direction.
Add a compact KPI summary strip above the reporting table. It should stay dense, utilitarian, enterprise-grade, and optimized for rapid scanning.
Rewrite the onboarding empty-state and validation messages so they are clearer, calmer, and more actionable while preserving the existing layout and styling.
Fix the existing modal so it traps focus correctly, closes on Escape, and restores focus to its trigger. Keep its appearance and layout unchanged.
